modmenu.descriptionTranslation.spark_fix: Fixes client shutdown hangs, ALI/JEI freezes, Chat Patches codec errors, waypoint disconnects, Axiom Chinese UI and font failures, REI transfers on plugin servers, and consumable use while rowing boats.
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.unavailable: Client-side recipe transfer is unavailable for this container
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.unsupported: This container layout does not support client-side recipe transfer
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.cursor: Make inventory room for the item carried by the cursor first
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.inventory_f: There is not enough inventory room to clear the recipe inputs
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.rejected: The server rejected part of the container operation; reopen the container and try again
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.failed: Client-side recipe transfer failed; items were kept in the inventory where possible
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.limit: REI transfer reached the configured click limit (%s) and stopped safely
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.menu_change: The open container changed while the transfer was running
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.overlap: This container uses the same slot as both recipe input and inventory
error.spark_fix.rei_transfer.busy: Recipe transfer is still finishing; try again in a moment
gui.spark_fix.xaero.delete_deathpoints_h: Delete Xaero's automatic deathpoints, including old deathpoints, from every set in the world/dimension selected above and save immediately. Keep regular and third-party waypoints.
gui.spark_fix.xaero.deathpoints_delete_f: Could not save deathpoints; restored the previous data. See the log for details
gui.spark_fix.xaero.delete_structure_way: Delete all Xaero waypoints written by Structure Finder in the current world/dimension and save immediately.
gui.spark_fix.xaero.structure_waypoints_: Could not save structure waypoints; restored the previous data. See the log for details
config.spark_fix.title: spark_fix settings
config.spark_fix.scroll_sensitivity_hint: Adjust scrolling in this settings screen. Applies and saves immediately. Default: 1.0×. Drag or use the left and right arrow keys.
config.spark_fix.integration_subtitle: Integration switches apply after restarting Minecraft
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_summary: Launch adofai from the pause menu
config.spark_fix.rei_summary: Add vanilla and unlocked recipes to REI
config.spark_fix.structure_finder_summar: Find and highlight vanilla structures in loaded terrain
gui.spark_fix.structure_finder.title: Structure Finder
gui.spark_fix.structure_finder.subtitle: Search loaded terrain for structures without a seed
gui.spark_fix.structure_finder.similarit: Adjust the percentage of matching block features immediately. Extra blocks do not lower it; lower percentages can mistake ordinary builds for structures.
chat.spark_fix.structure_finder.batch: Possible %s found; one is at %s. Highlights added.
gui.spark_fix.structure_finder.unreliabl: No reliable features: a chest alone cannot distinguish buried treasure, so automatic detection is unavailable.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layout_reset: Restore the default order and columns in Other settings. Keep favorites, values, names and aliases.
config.spark_fix.litematica_option_reset: Restore the default toggle and keybind of %s
config.spark_fix.litematica_config_unava: No registered Litematica configuration options were found
config.spark_fix.litematica_module_filte: Click to show or hide this mod's options. A green check means visible; a red cross means hidden. The mod stays enabled.
config.spark_fix.litematica_filter_favor: Off by default: the mod filters only affect Other settings. When on, they also hide the mod's favorites, preserving favorites and ordering.
config.spark_fix.litematica_modules_hidd: No visible settings. Click a red cross at the top left to show a mod's options again.
config.spark_fix.litematica_scroll_sensi: Adjust scrolling for projection settings independently, from 0.2× to 4.0× (default: 1.0×). Applies immediately; saved when this screen closes. Drag or use the left and right arrow keys.
config.spark_fix.litematica_hotkey_tools: Advanced keybind settings and reset for %s
config.spark_fix.litematica_option_cycle: Left-click for the next value, right-click for the previous value; left and right arrow keys also work.
config.spark_fix.litematica_numeric_mode: Switch between slider and numeric input
config.spark_fix.litematica_categories: Setting categories (scroll here in narrow windows)
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_mode_h: Choose all, single layer, layer range, all below or all above using Litematica's live render range.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_axis_h: Limit blueprint rendering along the X, Y or Z axis.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_single: Render only this coordinate on the selected axis.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_above_: Render this layer and all layers in the positive direction.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_below_: Render this layer and all layers in the negative direction.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_min_hi: The lowest coordinate included in the render range.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_max_hi: The highest coordinate included in the render range.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_move_m: Let the original layer movement hotkeys move the lower range boundary.
Let the original layer movement hotkeys move the upper range boundary.
config.spark_fix.litematica_layer_here_h: Move the layer or range to the camera's current position. Requires an open world.
config.spark_fix.litematica_color_hex_hi: Use #AARRGGBB (with alpha) or #RRGGBB (opaque). H is hue, S/V are percentages, R/G/B/A range from 0–255. Done applies the color; Cancel keeps the original.
config.spark_fix.litematica_string_list_: Enter one value per field. The expected value depends on this setting; blank fields are not saved.
One allowed block per field: use a block ID, #tag, or stone,c for contains matching. Applies when mining restriction uses the whitelist.
One blocked block per field: use a block ID, #tag, or stone,c for contains matching. Applies when mining restriction uses the blacklist.
Enter one block ID per field, such as minecraft:stone. Do not include brackets or quotes.
Enter one allowed container block ID per field, such as minecraft:chest.
One rule per field: source block ID => target block ID. Separate multiple blocks with |. Toggle the printer off once after changes.
config.spark_fix.litematica_alias_edit: Edit display names and search aliases
config.spark_fix.litematica_alias_new: Enter an alias and press Enter
config.spark_fix.litematica_name_move: Move to aliases (keep at least one main name)
config.spark_fix.litematica_favorites_em: Right-click a setting card to add it here
config.spark_fix.disabled_until_enabled: Enable this module to reveal its settings
config.spark_fix.rei_settings_unavailabl: REI is not installed; settings unavailable
config.spark_fix.rei_settings_failed: REI settings or statistics are temporarily unavailable. Check the log.
config.spark_fix.rei_empty_in_world: REI currently has 0 entries. Recipes may still be loading; try refreshing later.
config.spark_fix.rei_refresh_help: Read REI entry counts and the current server's recipe cache again. When capture is enabled, also save currently unlocked recipes.
config.spark_fix.rei_refresh_no_world: Join a world or server to view and refresh recipe statistics.
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_description: When enabled, the pause menu shows the adofai launcher. Right-click it to set a launch delay.
config.spark_fix.rei_missing: Roughly Enough Items (REI) is not installed, so REI Recipe Bridge settings cannot be opened.
config.spark_fix.restart_hint: Integrated module switches apply after restarting Minecraft; inline options save immediately and refresh recipes when the integration is loaded.
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_delay_right_cl: Right-click to set launch delay (currently %s seconds)
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_waiting: Please wait for the window to appear
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_failed: Launch failed; check Steam and the log
config.spark_fix.adofaigo_timeout: No window detected; check Steam's launch status
